# Game Icons touch silhouettes

Source: https://github.com/game-icons/icons
Version: commit `82d948812bfe3f269ef8f731dcdb07b08160edc4`.
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0),
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ . The upstream `license.txt`
is copied unchanged. These icons are not covered by the repository's CC0
license. Icons made by Delapouite, Lorc, John Colburn and Guard13007.

`TouchIcons.java` uses the generated Android VectorDrawables in
`port/android/app/src/main/res/drawable/touch_*.xml`. The supplied SVG files
are copied unchanged. Each Android conversion retains its 512 by 512
viewport and white foreground path verbatim, omits the black background,
and renders at the HUD's selected opacity. No other shape changes are made.
Attribution is also shipped in the APK as `assets/notices/game-icons.txt`.
